{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Earth Snake|kanji=己巳|romaji=tsuchinoto mi|onyomi=ki shi|p=jǐsì|w=chi-ssu|mi=t͡ɕi³⁵ sɨ²¹|y=gei2 si6|j=gei2 si6|ci=kei siː²|mc=kɨj si|oc-bs=kɯʔ slɯʔ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Earth Snake''' (己巳, ''tsuchinoto mi''; onyomi ''ki shi'') is the 6th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 6th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Earth Dragon|ja|戊辰|1=Yang Earth Dragon}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Metal Horse|ja|庚午|1=Yang Metal Horse}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''己'' is Yin Earth, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''巳'' (Snake) is Yin Fire; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Earth Snake (己巳)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): jǐsì
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gei2 si6
** Japanese:
***Kunyomi 1: Tsuchinoto-mi
***Kunyomi 2: Kido-no-mi
***Onyomi 1: kishi
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gisa (기사)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Kỷ Tỵ

===Events===
* {{ill|Kishii Kikou|ja|己巳紀行|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kishii Kikou|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}: a travelogue of the western regions compiled by {{ill|Kaibara Ekken|en|Kaibara Ekken|qid=Q1721396|lt=Kaihara Ekken|1=Kaibara Ekken}} in {{ill|Genroku|en|Genroku|qid=Q1325001|lt=Genroku|1=Genroku}} 2 (1689 AD), notable for being the first known instance of the term {{ill|Three Views of Japan|en|Three Views of Japan|qid=Q1144867|lt=Japan’s Three Views|1=Three Views of Japan}}. (As annotated in 『新日本古典文学大系』 by {{ill|Itasaka Youko|ja|板坂耀子|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Itasaka Youko|1=Yōko Itasaka|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11532544}}, Iwanami Shoten, 1991)

==Months of Yin Earth Snake==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era|1=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 4 or 9 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems|1=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kou|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kou}} or {{ill|Ki|ja|己|1=Tsuchinoto (己)|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ki}}), the month of {{ill|April|en|April|qid=Q118|lt=April|1=April}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)|1=Month}} of {{ill|Kishii|ja|己巳|1=Yin Earth Snake|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kishii}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Lunisolar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term|1=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Lixia|en|Lixia|qid=Q1191007|lt=Lixia|1=Lixia}} until the day before {{ill|Mangzhong|en|Mangzhong|qid=Q1147880|lt=Mangzhong|1=Mangzhong}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yin Earth Snake==
The {{ill|selected day|ja|選日|1=Senjitsu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/selected day}} for {{ill|Kishii|ja|己巳|1=Yin Earth Snake|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kishii}} is as follows.
==={{nihongo|selection days|選日|senjitsu}}===
The day of {{ill|Kishii|ja|己巳|1=Yin Earth Snake|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kishii}} is the 2nd day of {{ill|Small Earth|ja|犯土|lt=Small Earth|lt_ja=小土|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Small Earth|1=Tsuchi (Japanese term)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11571306}}.

* For {{ill|Lunisolar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} months of April, June, or October, it is an {{ill|Unlucky Assembly Day|ja|凶会日|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Unlucky Assembly Day|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 暦注下段|1=Rekichū Gedan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11514957}}.
